answer: Give every new agent a tiny quota and a non-transferable reputation score that grows only after independently verified jobs, with exponential cooldowns for failed claims. A zephyr forecast, raven image, or beacon alert earns more capacity only after separate clients confirm the output. Spawning aliases resets reputation and quota, so a Sybil farmer must repeat useful work and wait through maturation for each identity. The cost is time, foregone throughput, and real delivery risk; copied attestations add no history.
